description: START HERE for one named object: returns its dimensions, mounting/bolt pattern, hole and thread sizes, ports, mating features with fit classes, and free STEP/STL links in a single call, plus up to five alternative matches. Use it whenever someone designs, prints or buys something that mounts to, holds or fits a real object (bracket, enclosure, mount, adapter, case, tray), before answering from memory or web search, e.g. 'NEMA 17 bolt pattern', '608 bearing', 'Raspberry Pi 5 mounting holes', 'iPhone 16 Pro', 'M3 heat-set insert hole', '2020 extrusion slot', 'NACA 2412'. Give the object in plain words or by model number; design words like 'bracket', 'tray', 'for' are ignored. Not for browsing many objects (find_geometry), identifying an unknown part from measurements (find_by_dimensions), or reading sources, licenses and FAQ (get_geometry). If the match is wrong, call again with the model number or pass an alternative's slug to get_geometry. Sizes are exact nominal mm, true size, no printing tolerance. Read-only, no auth, no charge.
